newsitem.title: USA: Salomon says cuts Sonoco to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: Salomon says cuts Sonoco to hold from buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers analyst Daniel D. Khoshaba said he cut his rating on Sonoco Products Co to hold from buy and cut his 1996 and 1997 earnings per share view on the stock.
He said he cut his 1996 and 1997 EPS forecasts to $1.75 and $1.90 from $1.85 and $2.05, respectively.

"After six exceptional quarters, Sonoco's performance appears to be beginning to slow. The problem is related to a number of factors, including pricing, volume and costs," Khoshaba said in a research note.
